programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda bepergian ke Lembah Naga untuk menemui sahabat masa kecil yang dijanjikan untuk menjadi calon istrinya. Sesampainya di sana, ia menyadari bahwa keluarga sang mempelai wanita menyembunyikan banyak hal.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Ahli film laga Chang Cheh menceritakan kisah tentang Chin Feng yang bertemu dengan gadis cantik bernama Ting Hung saat tengah melarikan diri, setelah ia tak sengaja membunuh seorang pengganggu yang sombong.

programme.title: A Place To Call Home
programme.desc: Saat mengetahui jika dirinya adalah anak adopsi, Li Ching pergi untuk mencari keluarganya. Ketika situasi yang dialaminya menjadi semakin memburuk, ia akhirnya menyadari bahwa rumah adalah tempat yang terbaik.

programme.title: The Pure And The Evil
programme.desc: Reuni dua teman SMA yang semula manis segera berubah menjadi mimpi buruk erotis yang mengerikan ketika Rose tertarik pada mantan teman sekelasnya, Fang, dan tunangan barunya!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi, seorang ahli kungfu gaya Hong Quan bekerja di pabrik tekstil yang direkomendasikan oleh Han, seniornya. Han memperingatkan Yi untuk tidak memamerkan keahlian seni bela dirinya agar tak mendapat masalah.

programme.title: Between Tears And Smiles
programme.desc: Kwan Shan harus menyelamatkan wanita yang ia cintai, sebelum wanita itu dipersembahkan sebagai hadiah untuk seorang Jenderal!

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Shek Kin, yang biasa berperan sebagai tokoh jahat, mengambil peran langka di film komedi tentang hantu lucu yang berteman dengan seorang anak lelaki dan membantu sang anak menyatukan kembali orangtuanya yang berseteru.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: Sebuah film yang berkisah tentang sebuah hubungan cinta nan rumit antara sekelompok anak muda yang terjerat dalam ikatan cinta dan emosi.

programme.title: The Story Of Sue San
programme.desc: Wang adalah putra pejabat pemerintah yang dihormati, sedangkan Sue San adalah seorang wanita penghibur nan terkenal. Meskipun dan terlihat cocok dan saling mencintai, keduanya sangat berbeda dalam tingkatan sosial.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Saat mobil yang ditumpangi sejumlah gadis berpapasan dengan mobil yang ditumpangi beberapa pria, Ching Li dan Paul Chin Pei jatuh cinta. Namun, kisah cinta mereka tidak berjalan mulus.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: Seorang gadis bersumpah akan membalas dendam atas kematian orang tuanya oleh empat penjahat saat ia masih bayi. Ia pun berlatih seni bela diri, serta bekerja sama dengan seorang pendekar pedang dan suatu pasangan.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: Pada masa kemunduran Dinasti Ching, putra dari hakim lokal membunuh seorang pedagang keliling dan memperkosa istrinya. Sang istri dijebak atas pembunuhan suaminya oleh sang pemerkosa.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Dokter Sing merasa bingung dengan gejala-gejala aneh yang dialami pasiennya dan meminta bantuan pada temannya. Penyakit tersebut rupanya disebabkan oleh ilmu hitam yang dilakukan oleh seorang pria jahat bernama Kong.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agen Wen ditugaskan untuk menyamar sebagai pedagang senjata militer di Asia Tenggara guna menemukan beberapa amunisi dan menghancurkannya. Namun, ia diserang oleh gangster tak dikenal saat menemukan amunisi tersebut.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Seorang model (Joey Wong) diperkosa oleh seorang fotografer (Wilson Lam). Sementara itu, ia berselisih dengan sahabatnya (Carol Cheng) karena pacarnya (Alex Man), seorang polisi.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: Stephen Chow berangkat ke kota besar untuk mencoba menyelamatkan rumahnya dengan memenangkan turnamen snooker besar.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, yang pernah menjadi juara dunia tinju, melarikan diri ke Makau dari rentenir dan secara tak terduga bertemu Qi, seorang pemuda yang bertekad memenangkan pertandingan tinju.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Satpam Lee Go ditugaskan untuk menjaga sebuah rumah saat pemiliknya pergi. Namun, serangkaian kesalahpahaman lucu terjadi.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: Sebuah upaya pembunuhan yang gagal di Harbin, Cina pada tahun 1909 mengubah arah sejarah. Kini dua agen JBI harus menemukan hubungan antara benda tersebut dengan sebuah artefak Korea kuno.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detektif Lin membentuk unit khusus untuk menangkap perampok motor dan sindikat di balik aksi pencurian di Foshan usai istrinya yang hamil ditabrak oleh perampok motor.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: Seorang penulis yang putus asa menjalin persahabatan yang tidak terduga dengan seorang remaja dari Long Island.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Mantan kapten SWAT, Dong Gu, menderita kehilangan penglihatan traumatis kala gagal menjalankan misi. Namun, musuh bebuyutannya muncul dan membuat putrinya dalam bahaya. Ia pun harus berjuang menyelamatkan putrinya.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Mantan kapten SWAT, Dong Gu, menderita kehilangan penglihatan traumatis kala gagal menjalankan misi. Namun, musuh bebuyutannya muncul dan membuat putrinya dalam bahaya. Ia pun harus berjuang menyelamatkan putrinya.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang wanita berusia akhir dua puluhan yang menemukan kembali bakatnya dalam bertinju setelah lama absen. Secara tak terduga, ia bertemu dengan mantan pelatih tinjunya dan keduanya bekerja sama untuk membantunya mencapai babak final pertandingan tinju profesional.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley diberi kemampuan untuk menahan godaan dari lawan jenis namun hal itu menjadi beban ketika ia hendak menikahi kekasihnya.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Tiga orang lothario bersaing untuk menjadi kepala sekolah Sekolah Pelatihan Macho Man, sebuah lembaga yang sangat non-monastik yang didedikasikan untuk jenis latihan fisik yang sangat berbeda dengan Shaolin.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing dan kakaknya, Ma Tai Chueng, tiba di Shanghai untuk mencari peruntungan. Berteman dengan seorang gangster berkuasa, ia diberi klub malam sebagai imbalan atas penyelamatan nyawa Tam Sei. Sayangnya, seorang gangster lain juga menginginkan wilayah tersebut.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Seorang panglima perang Tiongkok menyewa seorang tukang sihir untuk membantunya mengesankan selirnya yang menolak.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing mengundurkan diri dari kepolisian setelah diturunkan pangkatnya ke bagian pengaturan lalu lintas, sementara rekannya ditugaskan dalam misi yang melibatkan teroris asing yang mengancam akan mengebom sebuah sekolah di Hong Kong, sehingga Sing memutuskan untuk membantu dengan menyamar di sekolah yang sama.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: Film ini bercerita tentang seorang imigran gelap asal Tiongkok, Cheung Kwan-chow, dan perjalanannya di New York.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: Seorang pria tunanetra, You Ji Ren, bekerja di sebuah pabrik di pulau terpencil. Karena badai, pabrik itu terisolasi dan muncul sesosok monster yang membuat siapa pun berubah menjadi bayangan hitam jika melihatnya.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Selama invasi Jepang ke Cina, seorang seniman bela diri yang kaya terpaksa meninggalkan rumahnya ketika kotanya diduduki. Dengan sedikit sarana untuk memenuhi kebutuhan mereka sendiri, Ip Man dan anggota kota yang tersisa harus menemukan cara untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Sepasang suami istri miskin, Shui dan Ti, berusaha membangun kehidupan mereka sendiri. Dan melalui kerja keras mereka berdua, Shui menjadi seorang eksekutif pemasaran, kemudian sikapnya mulai berubah.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: Ketika Qing Cheng masih remaja, ia diserang oleh monster mutan yang tidak dikenal dan kehilangan keluarga serta ingatannya. Ia dianggap oleh penduduk desa sebagai orang yang tidak menyenangkan yang akan membawa bencana.

programme.title: Review
programme.desc: After the international break, Review is back with highlights from Matchweek 4, starting with Arsenal facing Nottingham Forest, Everton hosting Villa, and the Manchester derby as United take on City at the Etihad.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Haaland) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: The Champions : PL Goats
programme.desc: Will Perry is joined by Premier League winners Owen Hargreaves and Peter Schmeichel to discuss the best title-winning teams in the Premier League era. Expect insightful anecdotes, interesting archive and lively debate across a packed hour-long programme.

programme.title: The Ipswich Way : PL Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievements in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season. As a new chapter begins with Gary O'Neil following the successful reign of Kieran McKenna, we explore how the spirit, identity and ambition of Ipswich Town continues to shape its future.

programme.title: Pochettino'S Spurs : PL Stories
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Cup, we revisit the rise of current USA manager Mauricio Pochettino's unforgettable Tottenham Hotspur side; the team that transformed Spurs from top-four hopefuls into genuine challengers at home and in Europe. Playing fearless, high-intensity football and built around a young core of stars, Pochettino's Spurs came within touching distance of Premier League and Champions League glory, creating some of the club's greatest modern nights along the way. Through exclusive interviews with Pochettino and the key players who drove that era, we tell the story of a team that changed expectations forever and ask how something so promising ultimately fell apart.

programme.title: Dean Ashton : PL Stories
programme.desc: We spend the day with Dean Ashton as he reflects on a career that promised so much and was cut short far too soon. From his rise through the Football League to becoming one of the Premier League's most exciting forwards with West Ham United, Ashton looks back on the goals, injuries and moments that shaped his journey in the game. Now working as a respected pundit, we see how his passion and understanding of football continue to drive him long after retirement.

programme.title: (Subbed) Diogo Jota : PL Stories
programme.desc: One year on from the tragic death of Diogo Jota and his brother Andre in a car accident, this deeply emotional PL Stories show celebrates the life of one of football's most loved figures. Through interviews with friends, teammates and coaches from Portugal to the Premier League, we look back on Jota's journey, the impact he had on those around him, and the legacy he left behind both on and off the pitch.

programme.title: Erling Haaland'S 100 : Netbusters
programme.desc: We celebrate Erling Haaland's record-breaking haul in true Netbusters' style, showcasing every one of his 100 Premier League goals, squeezed into a special 26-minute show.

programme.title: Norwich, The Nearly Men : PL Stories
programme.desc: We take a trip down memory lane to revisit the incredible story of Norwich City's unforgettable 1992-93 season; the campaign that saw an unfancied side come within touching distance of becoming the first-ever Premier League champions. Through interviews with the players and staff who lived it, we relive the pressure, drama and defining moments of a nerve-shredding title battle with Manchester United that could have changed English football history forever.

programme.title: Leicester City - Champions 15/16 : Rewind
programme.desc: Leicester City's Premier League triumph is one of the greatest underdog stories in the history of sport. Wes Morgan and Marc Albrighton recount the pivotal moments that defined their remarkable journey to the title.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.title: The Great North London Divide : PL Stories
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. We trace the origins of a feud shaped by geography, identity and decades of defining moments. We interweave the story of this season, which has reshaped the balance of power in North London and brings a fresh perspective to a rivalry already steeped in history. Through iconic matches and unforgettable characters, we capture what this rivalry has meant; and what it could become, as the two clubs look ahead to an uncertain future that may yet see them competing in very different circumstances.

programme.title: (Subbed) A Family United : PL Stories
programme.desc: 'A Family United', tells the story of the Singh brothers; lifelong Manchester United fans who have followed the club through every twist of its Premier League journey. From the glory years under Sir Alex Fergsuson to the highs and lows that followed, the brothers relive the moments, memories and matches that shaped both their lives and their bond as a family.

programme.title: The Centre Back With Joleon Lescott : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Once the unsung workhorses of English football, centre-backs have become some of the Premier League's most influential figures. This week, The Art of... sits down with two-time Premier League winner Joleon Lescott to explore how the role has evolved from last-ditch defending to a position that now shapes games, systems and titles. Joleon breaks down some of the key attributes of the role, and examines how the duties of the centre-back have expanded over time.

programme.title: Run The Race
programme.desc: Run the Race mengisahkan Zach dan Dave Truett, dua kakak beradik yang harus menghadapi kerasnya kehidupan setelah kehilangan ibu mereka dan ditinggalkan sang ayah. Zach memiliki bakat besar di dunia sepak bola dan berharap memperoleh beasiswa untuk mengubah masa depannya, sementara Dave rela mengesampingkan impiannya demi mendukung sang adik. Ketika berbagai rintangan menguji harapan mereka, keduanya belajar bahwa keteguhan hati, pengorbanan, iman, dan kasih keluarga merupakan kekuatan terbesar untuk menghadapi setiap tantangan hidup.

Namun, badai salju besar membuat mereka terisolasi dan harus menerima sebuah keluarga yang mengalami kecelakaan di jalan untuk berlindung bersama. programme.title: Ketemu Di Mimpi Is Level 34 Of Kangen
programme.desc: Saskia (Saskia Chadwick) baru saja putus dengan pacarnya, lalu temannya menyarankan untuk ikut open trip wisata. Ia bertemu dengan Yudha (Rizki Nazar) yang mengaku sebagai leader open trip tersebut. Saskia dan Yudha pun bersama menatap bintang di tengah hutan pada malam hari. Saskia pun syok saat bangun di rumah sakit karena pingsan dan pihak travel tidak ada yang mengenal Yudha. Mungkinkah Yudha hanyalah imajinasi dari rasa trauma Saskia saja?

programme.title: Pov Disekop-Sekop Cogan 34M Followers
programme.desc: Saat lagi rusuh sama El (Cinta Brian), Echa (Zoe Abbas Jackson) nggak sengaja bikin Tristan (Kevin Hillers) celaka, sampai Tristan gak sadarkan diri. Saking paniknya Echa dan El mengira Tristan udah pindah alam. Echa stress dan mau lapor Polisi. Tapi El bilang, nggak akan ada yang percaya Tristan tewas karena kecelakaan. El lalu berniat membuang jenazah Tristan, supaya mereka nggak ditangkap Polisi. Echa terpaksa setuju. Saat hendak membuang jenazah, Tristan malah sadar dari pingsannya. Echa dan El shock melihat Tristan bangkit dari kematian. Echa dan El yang panik nyerocos menjelaskan duduk perkaranya. Alih alih ngamuk, Tristan malah senang. Ternyata Tristan lagi jenuh sama rutinitasnya dan udah lama pengen liburan. Tristan malah minta Echa dan El nyari tempat.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Vino ini sehari-hari menghantui seorang gadis cantik yang diicarnya. Dikisahkan juga, Vino menjadi korban sebuah pertikaian asmara, yang menyebabkannya meninggal dunia. Anehnya tiba-tiba Vino memakai jaket klub naga dan membuat gadis itu merasa ketakutan.Namun seiring cerita, Vino terus saja membantu gadis tersebut untuk mendapatkan keselamatan dan keamanan. Sampai suatu hari, si gadis masuk rumah sakit, dan sahabat serta ibunya berkata, bahwa gadis itu selama ini berhalusinasi tentang keberadaan Vino atau cowok yang selama ini membantunya.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. programme.title: The Bird Catcher

programme.title: Spread
programme.desc: Sebuah film komedi dewasa yang menceritakan seorang pria hidung belang dan kekasihnya yang ia campakkan.

programme.title: Hours

programme.title: Food That Built World S4, Ep 32
programme.desc: Mantan pegulat Olimpiade Rocky Aoki dan seorang penjual parfum tak sengaja menjadi bapak revolusi santapan santai ketika mereka membuka sejumlah restoran yang berbeda di jantung kota New York.

programme.title: The UnXplained S8, Ep 6
programme.desc: William Shatner menelusuri berbagai misteri di balik bangkit dan runtuhnya kerajaan-kerajaan besar dunia. Mulai dari penyebab kemunduran Kekaisaran Inca dan keajaiban Machu Picchu, dugaan pelayaran bangsa Viking hingga ke Amerika Utara, hingga teori mengenai situs Gunung Padang di Indonesia yang memicu perdebatan di kalangan arkeolog. Dengan memadukan temuan arkeologi, bukti sejarah, dan pendapat para ahli, episode ini mengungkap bagaimana warisan peradaban kuno masih menyimpan banyak teka-teki yang belum terpecahkan.

programme.title: Malaysia's Horse Archers
programme.desc: Malaysia's Horse Archers mengikuti komunitas pecinta panahan berkuda yang berupaya menghidupkan kembali salah satu tradisi bela diri tertua di Malaysia. Melalui latihan intensif, pengenalan sejarah, serta pelestarian nilai-nilai budaya, dokumenter ini memperlihatkan bagaimana keterampilan memanah dari atas kuda diwariskan kepada generasi baru. Dipadukan dengan demonstrasi teknik yang memukau dan kisah para pelestarinya, film ini menghadirkan gambaran menarik tentang perpaduan antara sejarah, olahraga, dan identitas budaya Malaysia.

DI SISI LAIN, KIBO, DENGAN RAMBUT KERITING TEBALNYA, ADALAH SOSOK YANG CERIA, SELALU INGIN TAHU, DAN MUDAH BERTEMAN DENGAN SIAPA PUN. BERBEDA DENGAN WAKA, KIBO SERING KALI BERTINDAK TANPA BERPIKIR TERLEBIH DAHULU. KISAH PERSAHABATAN ANTARA WAKA DAN KIBO DI DESA MEREKA YANG PENUH WARNA DAN KEHIDUPAN MEMBAWA KITA PADA PETUALANGAN-PETUALANGAN YANG MENGHIBUR DAN MEMUKAU, DI MANA KEDUA KARAKTER INI BELAJAR DARI PERBEDAAN MEREKA DAN SALING MELENGKAPI SATU SAMA LAIN.

programme.title: Titipo Titipo
programme.desc: Titipo Titipo

programme.title: TITIPO TITIPO
programme.desc: KERETA LITTLE TITIPO YANG BARU LAHIR DI KOTA CHOO CHOO BARU SAJA LULUS UJIAN MENGEMUDI DAN SIAP BEKERJA DI DESA KERETA API. MESKIPUN TITIPO BERMIMPI MENJADI KERETA TERBAIK DI DUNIA, KEPRIBADIANNYA YANG PENASARAN MEMBUATNYA SELALU BERADA DI DALAM PERISTIWA DAN MASALAH YANG TIDAK TERDUGA SETIAP HARI. TITIPO MEMPERLUAS PENGALAMANNYA DI DUNIA YANG LEBIH BESAR DAN BERTEMAN DENGAN GENIE, DIESEL, DAN KERETA KECIL LAINNYA. AKANKAH TITIPO MENCAPAI MIMPINYA MENJADI KERETA TERBAIK? BERGABUNGLAH DENGAN PERJALANAN KERETA API DAN TEMUI TITIPO DAN TEMAN -TEMAN KERETA KECIL.

programme.title: Katuri
programme.desc: Katuri

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri adalah sebuah acara menarik tentang empat anak burung pegar yang tumbuh di hutan alami di bawah perawatan dan kasih sayang lembut ibu flora. Ibu flora selalu mendorong anak-anaknya untuk menjelajahi dunia bersama hewan lain dan membantu mereka kapan pun mereka membutuhkan. Ketika anak-anak burung merak mengalami kesulitan atau bahkan bahaya, ibu flora selalu ada untuk menjaga mereka tetap aman.

programme.title: Pororo The Little Penguin
programme.desc: Pororo The Little Penguin

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo si penguin kecil dan teman -temannya tinggal di tanah yang damai yang ditutupi salju dan es. Mereka semua memiliki kepribadian dan minat yang berbeda, yang terkadang menyebabkan sedikit masalah di dunia musim dingin yang tenang. tetapi selalu bersama-sama, setiap hari adalah petualangan di mana mereka belajar semua pelajaran hidup, baik besar maupun kecil !

programme.title: Shuke & Beita
programme.desc: Shuke & Beita

programme.title: SHUKE AND BEITA
programme.desc: DUA TIKUS, SHUKE DAN BETA, MENJADI MITRA DAN MEMULAI PETUALANGAN YANG MENAKJUBKAN. MEREKA MEMBANTU HEWAN LAIN DENGAN HELIKOPTER DAN TANK MEREKA DAN MENERIMA CINTA DAN PERSAHABATAN SEPANJANG PERJALANAN MEREKA.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey adalah serial animasi asal australia yang mengikuti petualangan sehari-hari seekor anak anjing ras blue heeler berusia enam tahun bernama bluey. Bersama adiknya, bingo, serta kedua orang tuanya, bandit dan chilli, bluey menjalani berbagai permainan imajinatif yang memicu rasa ingin tahu dan kreativitas.

programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Abang L The Explorer
programme.desc: Abang L The Explorer

programme.title: ABANG L THE EXPLORER
programme.desc: Abang l the explorer sebuah veriety show yang memberikan hiburan dan edukasi. Dimana abang l akan mengajak penonton bermain sekaligus belajar hal-hal seusia abang l dan berbeda disetiap episodenya. Tingkah lucu, gemas dan keaktifan abang l akan menjadi warna yang menghidupi program ini. Abang l yang pinter berbicara akan bertanya kepada orang di sekitar abang l. abang l juga akan mencoba beberapa profesi yang bertujuan untuk mengedukasi dari setiap peran profesi tersebut.

programme.title: Rainbow Bubblegem
programme.desc: Rainbow Bubblegem

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: Magic 5 The Animation
programme.desc: Magic 5 The Animation

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION MENCERITAKAN PETUALANGAN LIMA REMAJA ISTIMEWA—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, DAN IRSHAD—YANG DITEMUKAN DAN DIASUH OLEH FATHIR.KELIMA ANAK INI MEMILIKI KEKUATAN SUPER YANG UNIK DAN BERBEDA. MEREKA MENGGUNAKAN KEKUATAN TERSEBUT UNTUK MEMECAHKAN BERBAGAI KASUS DAN MASALAH YANG TERJADI DI SEKITAR MEREKA. SELAIN MISI PENYELAMATAN, MEREKA JUGA HARUS MENGHADAPI KONFLIK SEHARI-HARI DI SEKOLAH, TERUTAMA DARI GENG MUSUH MEREKA, THE BEAST. ANIMASI INI BERFOKUS PADA KISAH PERSAHABATAN, KEKOMPAKAN, DAN PENGGUNAAN KEKUATAN SUPER UNTUK KEBAIKAN.

programme.title: New Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: New Keluarga Somat

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: IKUTI PETUALANGAN SERU KELUARGA PAK SOMAT SAAT MEMULAI HIDUP BARU DI CITEKO! DARI MEMBANGUN WARUNG IMPIAN BU INAH, KEHEBOHAN BERTETANGGA DENGAN CEU KOKOM, HINGGA PERJUANGAN PAK SOMAT MENJADI OJEK ONLINE DEMI KELUARGA. KISAH HANGAT PENUH TAWA DAN PESAN MORAL YANG COCOK UNTUK SEMUA UMUR.

programme.title: Bioskop Keluarga Indonesia : Pororo and Friends: Virus Busters
programme.desc: Bioskop Keluarga Indonesia

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA SPESIAL LIBURAN CERIA (PORORO & FRIENDS: VIRUS BUSTERS)
programme.desc: BAHAYA MELANDA! KETIKA VIRUS KOMPUTER MISTERIUS MULAI MENYERANG DAN MENGACAUKAN KOTA, PORORO DAN KAWAN-KAWAN HARUS BERUBAH MENJADI TIM "VIRUS BUSTERS". DENGAN TEKNOLOGI CANGGIH, MEREKA SIAP MEMBASMI MONSTER VIRUS JAHAT!

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 27 HORIZON SEASON 2
programme.desc: LIKO, ROY, DAN DOT BERGABUNG DENGAN AKADEMI NARANJA UNTUK MENGIKUTI PELATIHAN TERA TRAINING, DI MANA MEREKA HARUS MENGHADAPI BERBAGAI GYM LEADER. SELAMA PERJALANAN, MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN TEMAN LAMA, RIVAL BARU, SERTA MENGHADAPI ANCAMAN DARI KELOMPOK EXPLORERS YANG MENGINCAR RAHASIA TERAPAGOS. SEMENTARA MEREKA MENGASAH KEKUATAN TERASTAL, MEREKA JUGA HARUS MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN TURNAMEN DAN SERANGAN MENDADAK DARI MUSUH.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Keluarga Somat

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: KELUARGA SOMAT MENCERITAKAN BAHWA KITA HIDUP HARUS SALING BERDAMPINGAN DAN MEMBANTU SATU SAMA LAIN SEBAGAI MASYARAKAT MAUPUN PELAJAR.

programme.title: A Town Of Blooming..., Ep 4
programme.desc: Tsukioka Mikoto (Fukumoto Riko), seorang perawat di sebuah rumah sakit kecil di Azumino, bertemu dengan seorang residen baru, Katsura Shotaro (Sugou Araki), yang kecintaannya pada bunga dan perilakunya yang agak tidak biasa membuatnya bingung. Namun, Shotaro tetap tenang dan blak-blakan bahkan di hadapan para dokter senior, yang secara bertahap menarik perhatian Mikoto. Di sebuah rumah sakit daerah yang menghadapi masalah populasi yang menua, idealismenya mulai bertentangan dengan pandangan para mentornya mengenai perawatan untuk memperpanjang hidup dan perawatan di akhir hayat, seiring dengan munculnya tantangan-tantangan baru yang harus mereka hadapi bersama.

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online merupakan program diskusi berita dari Sanlih News yang menghadirkan ulasan mendalam mengenai berbagai isu terkini di Taiwan maupun dunia. Dipandu oleh Hsu Kuei-ya, acara ini mengangkat topik politik, ekonomi, hubungan internasional, hingga isu sosial yang sedang menjadi perhatian publik. Melalui diskusi bersama jurnalis, pengamat, akademisi, dan narasumber terkait, program ini menyajikan analisis yang komprehensif dan beragam sudut pandang untuk membantu pemirsa memahami perkembangan peristiwa secara lebih mendalam.

programme.title: Mommy Says
programme.desc: Mommy Says adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang dipandu oleh Lin Shu-wei. Setiap episode membahas berbagai topik yang dekat dengan kehidupan sehari-hari, mulai dari perawatan kecantikan, tren busana, kesehatan, parenting, hingga tips menjadi konsumen yang cerdas. Bersama para ahli dan bintang tamu, acara ini menghadirkan informasi praktis, inspiratif, dan mudah diterapkan untuk membantu pemirsa menjalani kehidupan yang lebih sehat, percaya diri, dan berkualitas.

programme.title: Taoyuan Pearl Coast Music Fest.
programme.desc: Dari Pelabuhan Perikanan Zhuwei di Taoyuan hingga ke seluruh dunia, seniman internasional dan lokal berkumpul untuk pengalaman musik musim panas yang meriah.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: Top Singers menghadirkan para penyanyi berbakat yang menunjukkan kemampuan vokal dan gaya musik mereka melalui berbagai penampilan menarik. Setiap episode menampilkan interpretasi lagu-lagu populer, kisah perjalanan musik para penyanyi, serta momen spesial yang memperlihatkan bakat dan karakter unik masing-masing artis. Program ini menjadi wadah apresiasi bagi para musisi dan pecinta musik.

programme.title: Love Now
programme.desc: Love Now mengisahkan Yang Yi Ru, seorang eksekutif periklanan yang terlalu fokus pada pekerjaannya hingga membuat keluarga dan sahabatnya khawatir. Demi memaksanya beristirahat, mereka membuatnya percaya bahwa usianya tidak akan lama lagi. Dalam perjalanan yang dijalaninya, Yi Ru bertemu Lan Shi De dan perlahan menjalin hubungan yang penuh kehangatan. Di tengah berbagai kesalahpahaman, konflik keluarga, dan tantangan hidup, keduanya belajar tentang arti cinta, kepercayaan, dan pentingnya menghargai setiap momen dalam kehidupan.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour mengajak para selebritas untuk berkompetisi menyusun rencana perjalanan dengan tema dan anggaran tertentu. Dalam setiap episode, mereka mengunjungi berbagai destinasi wisata, mencicipi kuliner khas, serta memperkenalkan tempat-tempat menarik yang layak dikunjungi. Melalui pengalaman seru, interaksi yang menghibur, dan rekomendasi perjalanan yang praktis, program ini memberikan inspirasi wisata bagi para penonton.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang membahas berbagai isu menarik seputar kehidupan modern. Dalam setiap episode, para host bersama bintang tamu dan pakar mengulas tren kecantikan, fashion, kesehatan, hubungan, keluarga, hingga pengembangan diri melalui diskusi yang ringan namun informatif. Dikemas secara interaktif dan menghibur, acara ini memberikan inspirasi sekaligus tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: Girls Tease

Dikemas dengan suasana santai, interaktif, dan penuh humor, acara ini menyuguhkan informasi sekaligus hiburan yang relevan bagi penonton modern.

programme.title: Piala Presiden 2026
programme.desc: Turnamen pramusim paling bergengsi: PIALA PRESIDEN 2026! Segera digelar di dua stadion internasional, Stadion Si Jalak Harupat, Bandung, dan Stadion Gelora Bung Tomo, Surabaya, 25 Juli - 6 Agustus 2026. Memasuki edisi ke-8, PIALA PRESIDEN 2026 akan diikuti 8 klub dari 4 negara: Indonesia oleh Persib Bandung, Persebaya Surabaya, Persija Jakarta, Arema FC, dan PSMS Medan; Singapura oleh Tampines Rovers FC; Brunei Darussalam oleh DPMM FC; Tailan oleh Port FC, juara bertahan PIALA PRESIDEN 2025. Seluruh peserta siap berlaga dalam dua grup dengan total 16 pertandingan untuk memperebutkan gelar juara PIALA PRESIDEN 2026. Saksikan pertandingan Piala Presiden 2026 di SIN PO tv!

programme.title: Ngulik Politik
programme.desc: Ngulik Politik di Sin Po TV adalah program diskusi mendalam yang menganalisis isu-isu politik terkini di Indonesia. programme.title: Ruang Kabinet

programme.title: Piala Presiden 2026
programme.desc: Turnamen pramusim paling bergengsi: PIALA PRESIDEN 2026! Segera digelar di dua stadion internasional, Stadion Si Jalak Harupat, Bandung, dan Stadion Gelora Bung Tomo, Surabaya, 25 Juli - 6 Agustus 2026. Memasuki edisi ke-8, PIALA PRESIDEN 2026 akan diikuti 8 klub dari 4 negara: Indonesia oleh Persib Bandung, Persebaya Surabaya, Persija Jakarta, Arema FC, dan PSMS Medan; Singapura oleh Tampines Rovers FC; Brunei Darussalam oleh DPMM FC; Tailan oleh Port FC, juara bertahan PIALA PRESIDEN 2025. Seluruh peserta siap berlaga dalam dua grup dengan total 16 pertandingan untuk memperebutkan gelar juara PIALA PRESIDEN 2026. Saksikan pertandingan Piala Presiden 2026 di SIN PO tv!

programme.title: Le Telejournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: LE TÉLÉJOURNAL DE RADIO-CANADA
programme.desc: Le Téléjournal de Radio-Canada menyajikan liputan berita nasional dan internasional secara menyeluruh dengan laporan mendalam dan pembaruan terkini.

programme.title: Generation F
programme.desc: Richard Orlinski meets Souleymane Diamanka, a Franco-Senegalese poet and heir to the Peul tradition. A master of improvisation, he draws on his roots and the French language to create a vibrant contemporary poetry where each word is an explosion carrying memory and identity. With great boldness, Franco-Tunisian designer Farah Abidi combines haute couture and streetwear. She asserts an artistic vision in which her origins are expressed in XXL volumes, using noble materials, ancestral symbols and ethnic jewelry.

programme.title: GÉNÉRATION F
programme.desc: GÉNÉRATION F mengeksplorasi aspirasi, tantangan, dan kreativitas generasi muda yang membentuk ulang identitas serta peluang di Prancis masa kini. Melalui kisah personal dan analisis sosial, film ini menghadirkan potret generasi yang aktif dan penuh dinamika.

programme.title: Les Routes Du Gout
programme.desc: Marcel Ravin, a two-Michelin-starred chef at the Blue Bay restaurant, at the Monte-Carlo Bay Hotel & Resort, takes us to discover favorite places, from Monaco to Menton via Nice. An opportunity to explore Mediterranean flavors and Creole inspirations, through a responsible and generous cuisine.

programme.title: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT
programme.desc: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT menjelajahi berbagai daerah untuk menemukan bahan-bahan lokal, resep tradisional, dan para produsen yang menjaga kekayaan kuliner serta budaya di balik setiap hidangan.

programme.title: La Fievre Des Festivals
programme.desc: With most of the program planned outdoors, festivals are also exposed to climate change: organizers must take this into account and adapt to new realities. Cancelling a performance, an activity or a show remains the last resort.

programme.title: LA FIÈVRE DES FESTIVALS
programme.desc: LA FIÈVRE DES FESTIVALS mengikuti penyelenggara, para penampil, dan penonton dalam persiapan menuju berbagai festival spektakuler, menampilkan semangat kreativitas serta kemeriahan yang hadir di setiap acara.

programme.title: A Vrai Dire - Desinformation Climatique : Peril Sur La Planete
programme.desc: For the second issue of its major program against disinformation, TV5MONDE offers an original investigation in Argentina by journalists Simon Rodier and Lola Collombat. Climate skepticism, manipulations, pressure on scientists, environmental activists and journalists, law against glacier protection... In this country, climate denial is openly embraced and promoted by President Javier Milei. A report followed by a studio debate bringing together experts and committed personalities.

programme.title: Questions Pour Un Champion
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: À BOIRE ET À MANGER
programme.desc: GROOVE YOUR LIFE — Menggabungkan ritme, gerakan, dan energi positif, program ini mengajak penonton menjalani gaya hidup aktif melalui pengalaman yang menyenangkan.

programme.title: A Boire Et A Manger
programme.desc: Remi-Pierre, Lindsay and Vanessa are joined by Isabelle Racicot and Emile Bilodeau in a restored mill in Central Quebec. Honeyberries and regional cheeses are firmly in the spotlight, to the delight of all those present.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Festival International Du Rire De Liege - Geremy Credeville, L'Enquete
programme.desc: With his investigation, Geremy Credeville takes his guests on a fully improvised adventure. The concept? A fictional murder to be solved using clue objects brought by the audience! An absurd and irresistibly funny show featuring Antonia de Rendinger, Philippe Boxho, Renaud Rutten, Arnaud Tsamere and Issa Doumbia.

programme.title: FESTIVAL INTERNATIONAL DU RIRE DE LIÈGE - GÉRÉMY CRÉDEVILLE, L'ENQUÊTE
programme.desc: FESTIVAL INTERNATIONAL DU RIRE DE LIÈGE - GÉRÉMY CRÉDEVILLE, L'ENQUÊTE menampilkan humor cerdas, cerita jenaka, dan interaksi hangat Gérémy Crédeville dengan penonton dalam suasana festival komedi yang meriah.

programme.title: Festival International Du Rire De Liege - Antonia De Rendinger, Cas Cliniques
programme.desc: Welcome to the craziest psychiatry conference! For one night only, master of ceremonies and psychiatrist Antonia de Rendinger welcomes a series of colorful "patients" for a wildly offbeat show featuring Liane Foly, Giroud and Stotz, Les Freres Taloche, Manon Lepomme and other guests as talented as they are uncontrollable.

programme.title: FESTIVAL INTERNATIONAL DU RIRE DE LIÈGE - ANTONIA DE RENDINGER, CAS CLINIQUES
programme.desc: FESTIVAL INTERNATIONAL DU RIRE DE LIÈGE - ANTONIA DE RENDINGER, CAS CLINIQUES menampilkan aksi panggung penuh energi dari Antonia de Rendinger dengan karakter-karakter unik serta humor tajam yang terinspirasi dari kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: Lame De Fond
programme.desc: In Dinard, during a film festival, a drowned body is discovered. The victim: an English film director. The investigators are intrigued to discover that, a few years earlier, he was aboard a boat that sunk and his sister died in the accident. What is the connection between these two events?

programme.title: Lame De Fond
programme.desc: In Dinard, during a film festival, a drowned body is discovered. The victim: an English film director. The investigators are intrigued to discover that, a few years earlier, he was aboard a boat that sunk and his sister died in the accident. What is the connection between these two events?

programme.title: LAME DE FOND
programme.desc: LAME DE FOND mengikuti kehidupan orang-orang biasa yang harus menghadapi situasi luar biasa, memaksa mereka menghadapi rasa takut, pilihan sulit, dan konsekuensi dari setiap keputusan.

programme.title: La (Tres) Grande Evasion
programme.desc: Faced with tax evasion by multinational companies, political inaction increases suspicions of collusion among a population hit hard by the crisis. Increasingly taxed and victims of major inequalities, citizens have only one recourse and faint hope left: the ballot box.

programme.title: LA (TRÈS) GRANDE ÉVASION
programme.desc: LA (TRÈS) GRANDE ÉVASION memadukan permainan escape berskala besar, teka-teki strategis, dan misi petualangan yang mengharuskan peserta bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan tantangan sebelum waktu habis.

With their first two albums, Vaiteani have already shared their world. This time, they take us to Tahiti, at the heart of their musical archipelago!

programme.title: VAITEANI EN CONCERT À TAHITI

programme.title: Dessine Les Animaux Avec Koumi
programme.desc: Koumi is 6 years old, mischievous and always full of fun. The dream of her life is to know all the animals of the world, and she absolutely loves drawing! In each episode she explains how to draw animals really well.

programme.title: DESSINE LES ANIMAUX AVEC KOUMI

programme.title: C'Est Mathematique ! Avec Iman
programme.desc: Iman, a former maths teacher, offers primary school pupils a survival kit to help them approach secondary school with confidence. In each episode, using a fun and educational approach, he aims to make his subject clear and practical.

programme.title: C'EST MATHÉMATIQUE ! AVEC IMAN
programme.desc: Program edukasi di mana Iman menjelaskan konsep matematika melalui contoh menarik dan interaktif untuk anak-anak.

programme.title: Ta Vie Sans Ca
programme.desc: What would life be like without our most everyday objects? Each episode puts a different one in the spotlight. Whether a tap, an umbrella or a toothbrush, they all have a story to tell about their invention and subsequent evolution.

programme.title: TA VIE SANS ÇA
programme.desc: Ta Vie Sans Ça mengajak penonton membayangkan hidup tanpa benda, teknologi, atau layanan sehari-hari, serta merefleksikan kebiasaan modern.

programme.title: Mission Heros
programme.desc: At 8 years old, Amir leads the life of an everyday superhero. Thanks to his online avatar, he raises awareness among the children who watch him and throughout his neighborhood about civility and citizenship.

programme.title: MISSION HÉROS
programme.desc: MISSION HÉROS mengikuti peserta yang menghadapi tantangan fisik dan mental, membangun ketangguhan, kepercayaan diri, dan kerja sama tim sepanjang perjalanan mereka.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Belfort, the king's dog, and Lupin, the wolf of the gardens, live in the Palace of Versailles. As inseparable as they are unlikely, they come to the rescue of all their furry and feathered friends, from the royal menagerie to the local wildlife.

programme.title: BELFORT & LUPIN
programme.desc: Drama kriminal yang mengikuti kerja sama Belfort dan Lupin dalam memecahkan kasus sulit dengan perpaduan logika, insting, dan karakter yang berbeda.

programme.title: Les Triples
programme.desc: The triplets may look like angels, but they're not the last to get up to mischief... The two brothers and the sister are inseparable and as loving as they are mischievous. The adults need to be brave to channel their energy!

programme.title: LES TRIPLÉS
programme.desc: Les Triplés menampilkan petualangan lucu tiga bayi kembar dengan cerita visual sederhana dan minim dialog.

programme.title: Potobot
programme.desc: Twelve year-old Chloe is feeling somewhat disillusioned. Then Potobot, a little robot arrives from the future with a mission for her: to change the world and make the future a better place. There's no doubt about it, working together, one step after another, the two of them can move mountains!

programme.title: POTOBOT
programme.desc: POTOBOT menghadirkan perjalanan menarik ke dunia kreativitas digital yang memadukan teknologi dan seni visual. Setiap episode menampilkan teknik eksperimental, seniman muda, serta evolusi seni lukis di era digital. Dengan visual yang imersif dan pembahasan mendalam, program ini menunjukkan bagaimana teknologi modern mengubah ekspresi artistik.

programme.title: Liam
programme.desc: Alexis tells Liam that he is a weapon. Liam must find a way to protect humans from himself, even if it means sacrificing himself. The finalists of the science fair are revealed.

programme.title: LIAM
programme.desc: LIAM mengisahkan perjalanan emosional seorang anak muda yang menghadapi berbagai tantangan, hubungan keluarga, dan pilihan hidup penting hingga menemukan jati diri serta rasa percaya diri.

programme.title: Foot Go
programme.desc: Eight year-old Tata arrives in a new school. She wants to join its football team but isn't allowed to; after all she's a girl! Refusing to be beaten, Tata decides to set up her own girls' team with the help of her gang of friends.

programme.title: Marocains Du Ciel
programme.desc: Journalist Abdelhak Nassih offers Abdelwahed to write an article about Touria, the future first Moroccan female pilot.

programme.title: MAROCAINS DU CIEL
programme.desc: MAROCAINS DU CIEL — Menampilkan kehidupan dan pengalaman orang-orang yang berkaitan dengan dunia penerbangan, memperlihatkan semangat, ambisi, dan sudut pandang unik dari langit Maroko.

programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: Camille has returned to Montpellier to follow her dream of becoming a singer. When a musician from the group is found stabbed, Camille discovers that she had been the original target. For the police it's a race against time to find the murderer with a meticulously planned modus operandi.

programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: The lifeless body of a former fisherman, who had become a fisheries inspector, is discovered in the net of a trawler. Lea and Paul begin an investigation that will take them to the murky depths of fishing quotas and every type of trafficking.

programme.title: Desafio Ruta 40 Ypf 2026
programme.desc: Highlights of the Desafio Ruta 40 YPF, the third round of the W2RC 2026, the FIA-FIM World Rally-Raid Championship. Included in the programme in 2023 and 2024, the Argentinian event made its return this year for its thirteenth edition.

programme.title: PARTIR AUTREMENT ENTRE AMIS
programme.desc: Dua sahabat yang berprofesi sebagai seniman melakukan perjalanan untuk menjelajahi berbagai inisiatif pariwisata yang dikembangkan secara bertanggung jawab dan ramah lingkungan. Dalam perjalanan tersebut, mereka berkesempatan merasakan pengalaman budaya dan kemanusiaan yang luar biasa.

programme.title: A L'Ecole Des Vetos
programme.desc: Jeanne makes her first "dig" in a cow. Charline anaesthetises a dog before surgery, Alexandre helps to operate on a foal's umbilical hernia and Marine gives a tour of campus.

programme.title: À L'ÉCOLE DES VÉTOS
programme.desc: À L'ÉCOLE DES VÉTOS mengajak penonton melihat kehidupan di sekolah kedokteran hewan, saat para mahasiswa mengembangkan keterampilan medis, empati, dan pengalaman dalam menangani berbagai jenis hewan.

programme.title: A Bon Entendeur

Ia percaya bahwa romansa dan sensasi baru adalah bagian penting dalam hidup. Pandangan tersebut perlahan memengaruhi Bong-soo, adik iparnya yang setia kepada istrinya namun mulai tergoda oleh kehadiran perempuan lain. Ketika hubungan-hubungan rahasia dan berbagai godaan mulai memengaruhi kehidupan mereka, para tokoh harus menghadapi konsekuensi dari pilihan yang mereka buat. Dengan perpaduan komedi dan drama romantis, film ini membahas cinta, kesetiaan, pernikahan, dan dinamika hubungan orang dewasa secara ringan namun penuh makna.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. Sejak saat itu, Manda dan Indy hanya hidup bertiga bersama ayahnya, Indra. Manda berperan sebagai ibu bagi Indy. Suatu ketika ayah mereka mulai sakit sakitan dan masuk rumah sakit. Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.

programme.title: Cinta Yasmin

programme.title: Pay Later
programme.desc: Tika bermimpi menjadi influencer fashion. Untuk mendukung penampilannya, Tika jadi boros karena percaya diri akan diangkat sebagai pegawai tetap. Nyatanya, rekan kerja Tika berkhianat sehingga ia harus mencari pekerjaan baru demi membayar segala hutangnya.

programme.title: Flesh
programme.desc: Setelah seorang wanita muda dipaksa ikut serta dalam sebuah ritual aneh, tubuhnya mulai berubah. Taring dan cakar tumbuh di tubuhnya, dan ia mengalami hasrat aneh serta halusinasi saat ia berjuang untuk memahami apa yang sedang terjadi sebelum semuanya terlambat.

programme.title: The Taichi Master

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.desc: Oga loses the powdered milk that Hilda prepared for him, and instead buys a bunch of "Yogurty" from a vending machine for Beel. But it turns out that's the favorite drink of one of Ishiyama's Big Four, the "Ishiyama Tohoshinki"; the third year Kanzaki Hajime. Oga hears about how horrible and ruthless a guy Kanzaki is, and runs into the third year classroom to try and dump Baby Beel off on him. When he sees Kanzaki's evil looking face, Oga thinks that this just might be his chance!

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: Facing unemployment and his girlfriend's rejection, writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has no future. That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: Gerry [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Carter (Whoopi Goldberg) needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson (Sissy Spacek), but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband (Dwight Schultz) insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergrass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The Heart Of Me [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Set in 1930s London with two sisters, Madeleine married to Rickie, and Dinah, who falls in love with him. Rickie and Dinah begin an affair.

programme.title: Break Point [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A rough around the edges tennis pro is making one final crack at a major doubles tournament. Due to his drinking and on court attitude, other pros shy away from being his partner. He'll have to ask his younger brother for help if he wants to succeed.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after a successful assassination, a former mercenary finds himself the target of hit squads.

programme.title: Gerry [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: Facing unemployment and his girlfriend's rejection, writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has no future. That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

programme.title: The Messengers
programme.desc: When the Solomons trade in the craziness of big-city life for the quiet of a North Dakota farm, little do they expect the nightmare that follows. Soon after arriving, teenage Jess (Kristen Stewart) and her younger brother see terrifying apparitions and endure attacks from a supernatural source. Jess must warn her disbelieving family before it is too late to save them.

programme.title: Messengers 2: The Scarecrow
programme.desc: Sinister events plague a farmer (Norman Reedus) and his family (Heather Stephens, Claire Holt) when he places a scarecrow in his field.

programme.title: The Cabin in the Woods
programme.desc: When five college friends (Kristen Connolly, Chris Hemsworth, Anna Hutchison, Fran Kranz, Jesse Williams) arrive at a remote forest cabin for a little vacation, little do they expect the horrors that await them. One by one, the youths fall victim to backwoods zombies, but there is another factor at play. Two scientists (Richard Jenkins, Bradley Whitford) are manipulating the ghoulish goings-on, but even as the body count rises, there is yet more at work than meets the eye.

programme.title: Taboo
programme.desc: An unknown killer stalks six friends one year after they played a provocative parlor game.

programme.title: Paradise Hills
programme.desc: Young women must band together to escape from a seemingly idyllic island that holds a sinister secret.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: Sadie (Lucy Liu), a reporter, investigates an underground cult in Los Angeles which seems to be responsible for a series of grisly murders. While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: Cutthroat Island
programme.desc: Feisty Morgan Adams (Geena Davis) inherits her late buccaneer father's galleon and one-third of a map to buried treasure located on Cutthroat Island. The map had been tattooed on her father's scalp, and to find the treasure, she must locate and scalp his two brothers. programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: Boulevard! A Hollywood Story
programme.desc: Dickson Hughes and Richard Stapley, two young songwriters and romantic partners, find themselves caught in movie star Gloria Swanson's web when she hires them to write a musical version of "Sunset Boulevard."

programme.title: Punching at the Sun
programme.desc: In the aftermath of 9/11, a South Asian teen struggles to make sense of his brother's murder while developing a relationship with a girl from his neighbourhood.

programme.title: Rain Beau's End
programme.desc: When a progressive lesbian couple adopts a boy with a misunderstood genetic condition that was thought to predispose boys to violence and criminality, they must come to grips with their hardline stance on acceptance and toxic masculinity.

programme.title: Beguiled Company
programme.desc: A group of zillenials come together and embrace chaos by spinning out on a downward spiral of anarchic mayhem.

programme.title: Reapers
programme.desc: Reapers follows Zion, a resurrected soul collector, on a mission to save his wife. With ghouls, demons, and deadly deals with Death, he must stop a robust briefcase in this thrilling sci-fi action saga from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Clockwatchers
programme.desc: While she tries to determine her career goals, Iris (Toni Collette) becomes a temporary worker for Global Credit. There, all the regular employees ignore her, so she becomes friendly with three other temps: socializing actress Paula (Lisa Kudrow), conceited Jane (Alanna Ubach) and rebellious Margaret (Parker Posey). Though Margaret pines for a permanent job with the company, a rash of office thefts makes people suspicious of her, and Iris wonders whether to stand behind her new friend.

programme.title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
programme.desc: In this silent comedy, college boy William Canfield Jr. (Buster Keaton) reunites with his boat captain father in a Mississippi River town. Though he's flummoxed by Willie's citified appearance, the elder Canfield seems to have found an ally to help him compete with fellow riverboat owner John James King (Tom McGuire). Willie finds himself falling for King's daughter, Mary (Marion Byron), but he has more pressing concerns when the weather turns bad and his father in arrested.

programme.title: Going All the Way
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Stay Cool
programme.desc: A successful author (Mark Polish) reunites with a high-school beauty (Winona Ryder) when he returns to his hometown.

programme.title: Language Lessons
programme.desc: When Adam's husband surprises him with weekly Spanish lessons, he's unsure about where or how this new element will fit into his already structured life. However, when tragedy strikes, his teacher becomes a lifeline he didn't know he needed.

programme.desc: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teen-age Witch
programme.desc: The new girl (Melissa Joan Hart) in school gains strange powers which mean track stardom, a popular boyfriend and alienation from those who care about her.

programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.desc: A frustrated novelist begins to depend less on his imaginary friend when he forms a unique bond with a Long Island teenager.

programme.title: Suburbia

programme.title: Rock 'n' Roll High School
programme.desc: A teenager (P.J. Soles) and her friends get even with their principal to music by the Ramones.

programme.title: The Crush
programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.desc: A literary agent (Patricia Clarkson) whose husband left her and a Sikh driving instructor (Ben Kingsley) on the verge of an arranged marriage find that each has something to learn from the other about starting life anew.

But in college his uptight attitude doesn't win him any points with his sports-loving classmates, and pretty coed Mary (Anne Cornwall) ignores him in favor of brutish jock Jeff (Harold Goodwin). Hoping to impress Mary, Ronald makes a buffoon of himself at every sport imaginable, usually at Jeff's hand. But Ronald gets a final shot at glory in a big rowing race.

Gates and Agee dream of NBA stardom, and with the support of their close-knit families, they battle the social and physical obstacles that stand in their way. This acclaimed documentary was shot over the course of five years.

An orphan with few friends, Dinky is convinced that Carmichael is her birth mother, and that the actress will reclaim her when she returns.

It's not long before their professional relationship turns romantic, threatening their deadline and feelings for each other. Stars Shantel VanSanten and Victor Webster.

As she lays low and taps into the kids' talents in an attempt to become relevant again, she begins to realize that fame isn't everything. Stars Debbie Gibson and Robert Gant.

programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Desert Fiends
programme.desc: Six friends on their way to a concert break down in the middle of nowhere and encounter a deranged family that lives in the desert killing anyone they come across.

programme.title: From Embers
programme.desc: After the tragic loss of her husband Ron, Lily finds herself navigating a challenging new reality with her son Kevin. As they settle into a modest apartment, Lily's encounter with their neighbor Marty brings up an unexpected revelation about Ron's suspicious death. Marty is an alcoholic and his passion for music is only surpassed by his love for his daughter Chloe. When Lily delves deeper into the mystery surrounding Ron's demise, she forms a bond with his co-worker Angela.

programme.title: Wind and Bone
programme.desc: A woman on the run joins a group of college students in rural West Virginia, where they soon encounter the Wendigo.

The mastermind of it all is crime lord Silvio and his vicious gangsters who forces Karina and Covek, a deadly killer threatened by him, to go on a journey against time.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove

programme.title: Lonesome Dove

With the predator population on the rise, and increasing encounters placing lives and livelihoods in peril, Great White Summer chronicles a season of struggle as people demand action, priorities are questioned, personal allegiances shift, and growing suspicion clouds the waters.

Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.
